verdict.rationale:
Mastra ships built-in scorers/evals for measuring agent quality and 'live evaluations' that automatically score outputs, giving an engineering lead a way to quantify agent quality (mastra-docs-7, mastra-docs-24). However, there is no evidence of CI-specific integration (e.g., running evals as automated test assertions in a pipeline, CLI eval commands, or CI examples).
missing for 10: CI/test-runner integration examples, evidence of evals being run as automated gating checks in a pipeline.
